description: Declaration of the PUSCH decoder interface for 5G NR uplink shared channel processing, including configuration, decoding method, and softbit handling.

classes.name: ocudu::pusch_decoder
classes.description: Interface for decoding PUSCH codewords, recovering UL-SCH transport blocks, and managing decoder configuration.

methods.name: pusch_decoder::new_data
methods.description: Configures and initiates decoding of a PUSCH codeword, returning a buffer for softbit input.

methods.name: pusch_decoder::set_nof_softbits
methods.description: Sets the expected number of softbits for the codeword, enabling early decoding.
